messages:
alex: Heads up folks, I'm heading to Boston Seaport next week for a couple days. Need: one reliable lunch spot near the office, one 'treat-yourself' dinner, and a quick carryout option near the convention center for a late-night catch to the airport. Any recs?
jamie: Lunch: Flour + Bread has fast sandwiches and is right by the ferry. Tatte is a reliable cafe for salads and pastries.
taylor: Dinner if you want fancier: O Ya (sushi, splurge) or Mastro's for steak vibes. For something more local-y, check out Row 34 for oysters.
alex: Nice. Any low-key late-night tacos or something open late for a flight-night dinner?
jamie: Not many 24hr places in Seaport. Taqueria near the Financial District stays later sometimes. Also, Little Donkey has late service some nights. Check hours.
taylor: For quick carryout near the convention center: Sweetgreen or CAVA for fast bowls. If you want seafood to-go, Legal Sea Foods kiosk at the center is decent.
alex: Coffee + outlets for a 90-min sprint Wed morning?
jamie: Blue Bottle on Seaport has plugs and is laptop-friendly early. District Hall has communal tables but can be noisy.
kitchen-bot: Reminder: office kitchen stocked with snacks Thursday 3pm :cookie: (not Boston-related but for your return).
alex: ha, noted. Any 'sneaky gems' people recommend for dessert or a weird local must-try?
taylor: North End cannoli > everything. Also, if you have time, get a lobster roll at a small shack if weather's good 609
jamie: Pro tip: bring a light jacket for the waterfront. Food lines move fast in lunchtime windows.
alex: Amazing, building a tiny food map now. Thanks y'all! :raised_hands:
